Job description:

 
The Senior Tradesperson (Carpenter) reports directly to the Site Coordinator, Facilities and Engineering and operates with a high level of independence in undertaking day-to-day activities.

 

 






 

 

The Team

Launceston General Hospital (LGH) is one of Tasmania's major public hospitals, providing comprehensive healthcare services to the northern region of the state.

Working across the LGH facility and surrounding precinct the Carpentry team are responsible for carrying out building maintenance, repair work and undertake minor construction projects where required on all Department of Health (DoH) buildings to appropriate standards to ensure safety of the public, staff and patients as well as assisting other staff as required in the day to day operations of the Facilities and Engineering Department.

All our services work closely together to focus on delivering excellence in healthcare infrastructure to achieve improved outcomes for our consumers, our workforce, and the Tasmanian community.

The Role

The Senior Tradesperson (Carpenter) reports directly to the Site Coordinator, Facilities and Engineering and operates with a high level of independence in undertaking day-to-day activities. The occupant:

Provides leadership for the Carpentry Trades to ensure a highly cohesive team that can efficiently service health care facilities including a complex hospital environment within the Department's work responsibility area.

Is responsible for supervising carpentry trade staff, contractors and consultants as appropriate.

Communicates professionally with internal staff within the Facilities and Engineering Team and externally to a variety of consultants, contractors, suppliers, Manufactures and other Government Agencies when required.

Ensures compliance with Work Health and Safety Legislation and Australian Standards.

Champions a child safe culture that upholds the National Principles for Child Safe Organisations. The Department is committed to the safety, wellbeing, and empowerment of all children and young people, and expect all employees to actively participate in and contribute to our rights-based approach to care, including meeting all mandatory reporting obligations.

At all times complies with policy and protocol requirements, including those relating to mandatory education, training and assessment.

You will need

Demonstrated ability to prioritise own work and the work of other trades staff to accomplish project timeframes and make responsible recommendations along with the ability to keep and maintain records.

Demonstrated ability to interact and communicate effectively with staff at all levels from various organisations along with the ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Demonstrated sound experience in, and extensive knowledge of, carpentry trade services including the ability to modify, commission, repair and maintain services and equipment within a health care environment.

Note: - Please refer to the Statement of Duties for all the selection criteria of this position to address in your application.

Why Tasmania

The Department of Health Tasmania oversees various hospitals across the state, including the Royal Hobart Hospital, Launceston General Hospital, Northwest Regional Hospital, and Mersey Community Hospital, as well as district hospitals and ambulance services. Additionally, it provides community health, mental health, and primary healthcare services to the Tasmanian community through more than 300 sites.

Tasmania, Australia's only island state, offers unparalleled natural beauty and a luxurious lifestyle. Pursuing your health career in Tasmania's public health system means building strong connections with colleagues and patients. It also means embracing a lifestyle where you can enjoy extraordinary experiences outside of work while making a significant impact on the community during work.

Details of appointment

Permanent full time, day worker position, working 76 hours per fortnight, commencing as soon as possible.

*Notwithstanding hours to be negotiated with the successful applicant.

Applicants should note that, for a period of twelve months from the date of publication, this selection process may be used to fill subsequent or similar full time, part time, and casual vacancies.

Position Features: 

This role requires on-call availability and offers attractive renumeration for both standby availability and callback duties.

Travel may be a requirement of this role as work may be performed at other offsite facilities across Northern Tasmania.

Salary

$85,196 to $97,915 per annum. Our Employer 12% superannuation contribution is on top of this amount.

Salary range is in accordance with Public Sector Unions Wages Agreement 2025

Salary Packaging

Benefits available to eligible candidates

A range of leave entitlements, including study leave and Professional Development Support.

Fitness Passport - You, and your family can access 40+ fitness facilities across Tasmania for just $14.50 per week per person, or $28.05 for a family.

More information about our Employee Benefits can be found here

Eligibility

Relevant Trades Qualification

Certificate III Wood Machining.

About the role
Melbourne Automotive Engineering has been delivering trusted repairs, diagnostics, and tuning from our Bundoora workshop to Melbourne drivers and major insurers alike. With a scope that covers everything from routine servicing through to complete engine rebuilds, we are now looking for an experienced Mechanic to join our team. This is a hands-on trade role for someone who takes their work seriously and holds themselves to a high standard on every job, regardless of what comes through the door.

Key responsibilities
- Work across a steady mix of servicing and repair jobs, managing your own time and keeping jobs moving without sacrificing the standard of work
- Diagnose problems properly, using both hands-on knowledge and electronic diagnostic equipment to find the actual fault before touching anything
- Carry out repairs and mechanical rebuilds accurately, using manufacturer documentation as the benchmark and verifying your work before anything goes back to the customer
- Handle routine maintenance with the same attention as the bigger jobs, because preventative work done well keeps customers off the lift longer
- Assess vehicles for roadworthiness and prepare accurate reports or certificates where your qualifications allow

About you
- Trade-qualified mechanic (or with relevant experience) with genuine workshop experience and the diagnostic ability to back it up
- Someone who takes pride in their work and doesn't cut corners when rebuilding or reassembling
- Comfortable with computerised diagnostic tools and able to interpret what they're telling you
- Organised and self-directed, able to move between jobs without losing focus on quality
- Current driver's licence essential

Position: Aged or Disabled Carer
Type: Full-time
Employer: SA Nursing Care
Location: Greenacres SA 5086
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business
SA Nursing Care Pty Ltd is a trusted registered provider under the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), based at 8A Arunta Street, Greenacres, South Australia. We deliver compassionate, high-quality personal care, daily living supports, community participation assistance, capacity building, and specialised high-intensity supports to individuals with disabilities and those requiring aged care across the Adelaide metropolitan area. Our strong reputation rests on a genuine commitment to empowering clients to maintain their independence, dignity, and quality of life in their own homes and communities. Guided by our core values of compassion, excellence, integrity, and empowerment, we foster a supportive, inclusive, and professional workplace culture where every team member is valued, receives ongoing development, and works collaboratively to make a meaningful difference in the lives of our clients.
About the Position
The Aged or Disabled Carer plays a vital and hands-on role at SA Nursing Care, providing essential daily support that helps our clients live safely, comfortably, and with dignity at home. Working to individualised NDIS support plans, you will assist with mobility, personal care, meal preparation, light household tasks, and social engagement, always promoting client choice, independence, and wellbeing. This position is central to our person-centred model of care and contributes directly to positive outcomes for the people we support across Greenacres and the broader Adelaide region. As a valued member of our dedicated team, you will help uphold our high standards of compassionate, reliable service while enjoying the reward of truly meaningful work.
Key Responsibilities
Assist clients with mobility, transfers, and positioning using safe manual handling techniques to promote comfort, safety, and independence.
Prepare and serve nutritious meals and snacks in accordance with individual dietary requirements, preferences, and cultural needs.
Arrange and actively support clients to participate in social, recreational, and community activities that enhance connection, mental wellbeing, and quality of life.
Provide respectful personal care assistance, including bathing, dressing, grooming, and toileting, while always protecting the client’s dignity, privacy, and consent.
Support clients with light household tasks such as cleaning, laundry, and shopping to maintain a safe and comfortable home environment.
Offer companionship, emotional support, and encouragement to reduce social isolation and build positive, trusting relationships.
Observe, document, and promptly report any changes in a client’s physical health, behaviour, or support needs to the supervisor or relevant professionals.
Follow individual NDIS support plans and contribute consistently to the achievement of each client’s personal goals.
Adhere to all workplace health and safety requirements, infection control procedures, NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission standards, and organisational policies at all times.
Requirements
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Minimum AQF Certificate II or III in Individual Support (Disability), Aged Care, or an equivalent relevant qualification.
At least one year of relevant experience in a caring role supporting people with disabilities or older Australians.
Strong technical skills in safe manual handling and personal care, combined with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including empathy, active listening, patience, and the ability to build rapport with clients and families from diverse backgrounds.
Demonstrated commitment to person-centred care that respects individual dignity, choice, and independence.
Physically fit and capable of performing manual handling and personal care duties safely; current or willingness to obtain Manual Handling and First Aid/CPR certifications.
Current or willingness to obtain an NDIS Worker Screening Check clearance and any other required background checks.
Excellent time management, reliability, and organisational skills, with flexibility to work rostered shifts that may include weekends and public holidays.
Current driver’s licence and access to a reliable vehicle (highly desirable for community-based roles).
How to Apply
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

## ICT Support Technician
## Position Overview
We are looking for a motivated and technically proficient ICT Support Technician to join our team and provide reliable support across our computer infrastructure, software systems, and web technologies. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues, maintaining hardware and software environments, and ensuring end users receive timely and effective assistance. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with strong communication skills and a genuine passion for technology. This position suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to delivering high-quality technical support.
## Key Responsibilities
- Assess software and hardware requirements to identify appropriate technical solutions and resolve user-reported problems effectively.
- Respond promptly to enquiries from staff regarding software and hardware issues, providing clear guidance and practical resolutions in a professional manner.
- Install, configure, and maintain approved software applications, ensuring systems remain up to date, secure, and aligned with organisational standards.
- Adapt and modify existing programs and system configurations to better meet the evolving needs of end users and business operations.
- Implement, configure, and monitor computer networks, supporting both wired and wireless infrastructure to maintain consistent connectivity across the organisation.
- Design, update, and maintain organisational websites, ensuring content accuracy, functionality, and a positive user experience.
- Repair and replace peripheral equipment such as printers, terminals, monitors, and modems, maintaining accurate records of assets and service activity.
- Provide first- and second-level technical support to end users, either in person, remotely, or via a helpdesk or call centre environment, logging all incidents and resolutions through the appropriate ticketing system.
- Promote the efficient and effective use of applications and equipment across teams, offering training and guidance where required.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to escalate and resolve complex technical issues in a timely manner.
- Conduct routine system checks, preventative maintenance, and performance monitoring to minimise downtime and ensure infrastructure reliability.
- Maintain thorough technical documentation, including user guides, network diagrams, and records of system configurations and changes.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Certificate III or IV in Information Technology, or a relevant tertiary qualification in ICT, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in a technical support, helpdesk, or IT operations role.
- Solid understanding of computer hardware components, operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux), and common business software applications.
- Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting software and peripheral devices.
- Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and LAN/WAN connectivity.
- Familiarity with web technologies and basic website maintenance, including content management systems.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose technical issues efficiently and accurately.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and maintain composure under pressure.
- A customer-focused approach with a professional and courteous manner in all interactions.
## Preferred Qualifications
- CompTIA A+, Network+, or equivalent industry certification.
- ITIL Foundation certification or familiarity with ITIL service management principles.
- Experience working in a managed service provider (MSP) or enterprise IT environment.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft 365, Azure, or Google Workspace.
- Experience with remote desktop tools and helpdesk ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, Freshdesk, or Jira Service Management.
- Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and endpoint protection solutions.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and supportive team culture that values continuous learning and professional growth.
- Access ongoing training, certification support, and clear pathways for career advancement within the ICT field.
- Enjoy a stable, full-time permanent role with a competitive salary and superannuation package.
- Benefit from flexible working arrangements and a healthy work-life balance in a forward-thinking organisation.
- Work with modern technology and contribute to meaningful projects that directly support business operations and user experience.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Designation / Job title : Cyber Security Anlayst - 262116

Primary or Mandatory skills :-
•	Business analyst expert in managing large scale cyber security, risk management and digital transformation projects with aggressive timelines
•	Project Management

Good to have skills :
•	Identity & Access Management
•	Zero Trust & Cloud Security
•	Program Management and Architecture framework

Detailed Job description : -
Project Planning & Execution
•	Scope Definition: Define project scope, deliverables, and goals in collaboration with executive sponsors and security teams.
•	Roadmapping: Develop comprehensive project plans, schedules, and milestones using standard methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).
•	Resource Allocation: Assign tasks to security analysts, engineers, and external vendors while managing workloads effectively.

Budget & Risk Management
•	Financial Oversight: Manage project budgets, track expenditures, and build business cases for new security software or tool procurement.
•	Risk Mitigation: Identify potential roadblocks—such as technical limitations or delayed vendor deliveries—and develop proactive contingency plans. 

Stakeholder Communication & Governance
•	Reporting: Provide regular project status updates, highlighting budget, timelines, and security metrics for leadership teams.
•	Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align diverse teams (IT, legal, HR, and external contractors) to ensure unified support for security rollouts. 

Compliance & Security Standards
•	Framework Alignment: Ensure project deliverables comply with established security frameworks, regulations, and legislation (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR). 
•	Governance Enforcement: Support risk management by ensuring proper change processes are followed, such as during code reviews, accreditation phases, or penetration testing.

Rendine Construction is seeking a skilled Construction Project Manager in our facility in Moolap VIC.

You will lead and mentor closely with internal stakeholders, and support the implementation of best-practice systems, technical processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan, allocate, and coordinate labor and resources.
- Monitor project progress against schedule, quality targets, and budget, escalating issues where required.
- Provide technical advice and support with MDR (Manufacturer Data Record) requirements.
- Provide leadership to the specialized construction and installation teams.
- Drive adherence to OHS, QA, and internal compliance systems.
- Mentor team members, encourage skills development, and support implementation of improved workflows.
- Ensure accurate job costing, reporting, and keeping across all projects.
- Uphold integrity, transparency, and professionalism in all dealings with internal and external stakeholders.

Skills & Experience Required
To be considered for this role, candidates should demonstrate:
- At least 1 year of experience

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering (or equivalent).
- First Aid Level 2 certification.
- Evidence of ongoing professional development.

Technical & Professional Skills
- Strong ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across teams.
- Experience analyzing and resolving complex technical and operational issues.
- Effective communication and organizational skills.
- Ability to lead and support teams under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
- Demonstrated initiative, leadership capability, and sound judgement.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Project).


Salary range is $75,000 - $90,000pa commensurate with experience.

Fulltime Position available

Applications open on 9th July 2026 and closes on 9th August 2026

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted
